descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S10 「养老院：一个 4 天前、3 次就诊之前的没完成任务，最后一次处理是 2 天前，在今天的就诊时仍然没完成，在病历上和 Task Export 上都是」 Nursing Home: an open task 4 days and 3 visits old, last processed 2 days ago, is still open at today's visit, on the chart and on Task Export

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U6 Nursing Home open tasks persist across visits (UAT 3.6: open tasks persist until changed)（UAT TC-07；UAT 3.6；TFA-92585 AC 10） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U1 One consolidated in-app end-of-day view lists every open task across all of the physician's patients, each attributed to its patient（UAT TC-07；TFA-92585 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home（UAT TC-07；UAT 3.3；TFA-92585 AC 12） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given A resident seeded with three earlier visits (server-today − 4 d, − 3 d, − 2 d), chart last processed server now − 2 d, and an open task created at the first of them (server now − 4 d); on Today's Visits

When Open Task Export; open the resident, type a pre-round text and tap Save Note (today's visit starts); open Post-Round; open Task Export again

Then The task is open under the resident on Task Export before and after today's visit starts, and on the chart's Post-Round tab

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：U6 / 3.6 Nursing Home 'open tasks persist until changed'. The task is older than 36 h, the chart was last processed more than 36 h ago and the task predates the 'last two visits' window, so a Hospital-style 36 h open-task clear or a visit-window clear leaking into Nursing Home would remove it (with a 1-day-old seed it would not). …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟）；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S10 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-07.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟）（TIME (back-dated seed: three earlier visits, notesProcessedAt -2 d, task created -4 d)）；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
